description:
OWNER PAUSE. This is the only planned interruption.

1. Agent: post a summary in chat:
   - the rehearsal receipts, probe results and rollback drill run ids;
   - the variable changes it will make.
   Then run `gh workflow disable site-deploy.yml -R BenchBox-dev/BenchBox`. Core Pages and its last deployment stay in place as the rollback target.
2. Owner, in a low-traffic window: remove benchbox.dev from core Pages and add it to the site Pages. DNS does not change.
3. Agent: poll the site Pages API every 2 minutes, for at most 60 minutes, until the certificate is approved, then enforce HTTPS. On timeout, ask the owner to move the domain back, re-enable core site-deploy.yml, and stop.
4. Agent: set SITE_ORIGIN=https://benchbox.dev and SITE_HOST=benchbox.dev. Ask the owner for go in chat (D19). Only then set SITE_DEPLOY_TARGET=production and dispatch a deploy.
5. Agent: verify:
   - probes are green and a receipt exists;
   - /, /docs/, /docs/dev/, /blog/, /results/, 404.html and objects.inv all serve;
   - no page carries noindex;
   - the CLI URLs resolve: https://benchbox.dev/docs/ (cli/app.py:30, onboarding.py:99), /docs/contributing-results.html (cli/commands/submit.py:72,99,500) and /results/r (submit_service.py:17).
6. Evidence before site-split-50 starts:
   - one production deploy per route class, each with green probes: docs through a core bundle, blog and landing through a site merge, and a results-data change through a bundle;
   - one production rollback drill to a site receipt, then forward again.
   Wait for natural core merges for the bundle classes. Do not create artificial core changes; if none arrive, ask the owner.
